<p>Version 2026-11-03 · Last updated: 3 November 2026</p>

<p>This policy explains what happens to the fees you pay for Velstrian Tenderworks. It is part of the Terms of Service and applies to all paying customers unless a signed order form says otherwise.</p>

## 1. Fees are non-refundable

<p>You pay for each month or year in advance. Fees you have paid are not refunded, in whole or in part, and we do not give service credits or other compensation.</p>

## 2. Cancel any time

<p>You can cancel at any time from the billing page in your account settings, or by emailing <a href="mailto:contact@velstrian.com">contact@velstrian.com</a>. Nothing more is charged after you cancel, and your plan keeps working until the end of the month or year you have already paid for.</p>

## 3. Changing plan

<ul><li><strong>Moving to a bigger plan:</strong> the change starts straight away. You pay the difference for the rest of the current period, and the app shows the amount before you confirm.</li><li><strong>Moving to a smaller plan:</strong> the change starts at the end of the period you have paid for, so you keep the bigger plan until then.</li></ul>

## 4. Payments taken in error

<p>If a payment is taken by mistake, for example the same invoice charged twice, email us with the invoice numbers and we will put it right.</p>

## 5. Chargebacks

<p>Please contact us before you ask your bank for a chargeback. We can usually sort out a billing question faster than your bank. Chargebacks carry a fee from Stripe, which we may pass on if the chargeback is decided in Velstrian Tenderworks&#x27;s favour.</p>

## 6. Business customers only

<p>Velstrian Tenderworks is sold to businesses and other organisations, not to consumers. The consumer refund and cancellation rules, such as the 14 day cancellation period under the Consumer Contracts Regulations 2013, therefore do not apply. Nothing in this policy limits a right that the law does not allow us to limit.</p>

## 7. Governing law

<p>This policy is governed by the laws of England and Wales.</p>
